Smt Poonam Goel vs State Of U.P And 6 Others on 6 November, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154855045/
1

 Hon'Ble Sameer Jain, J. 
1.

Sri Kapil Tyagi and Ms. Sindhuja Rathi Bhargava, learned counsel for the applicant and R. N.
Srivastava, learned Aga for the State-respondent are present.

2.  The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to transfer the proceeding of Case No. 171 of 2023 arising out of case crime No. 007 of 2023, u/s 498A, 323, 504 IPC, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Hapur, pending in the Court of Civil Judge (JD), Fast Track Court-II/Judicial Magistrate Hapur to concerned court of District Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge (JD), Fast Track Court-II/Judicial Magistrate Hapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is wife of the opposite party no. 2 and she filed instant transfer application with a prayer to transfer the trial of the case related to offence under section 498A IPC from District Hapur to District Gorakhpur but applicant is ready to appear through video conferencing and therefore, the instant application may be disposed off with the direction that if applicant filed an application before appropriate forum to appear through video conferencing then her application shall be entertained and she will be permitted to appear through video conferencing.
4. Learned AGA is having no objection.
5. The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicant who is wife of the opposite party no. 2 with a prayer to transfer the case from District Hapur to District Ghaziabad but now she is ready to pursue the matter through video conferencing, therefore, instant transfer application is being disposed off with a direction that if applicant filed an application to pursue through video conferencing then her application shall be considered and she will be permitted to pursue the matter through video conferencing.
(Sameer Jain,J.) November 6, 2025 Ankita  Smt Poonam Goel vs State Of U.P And 6 Others on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154855045/
